title: Clinton
detail: Bill Clinton is president at enlistment. In office 20 January 1993 to 20 January 2001.

title: Embassies
detail: Bombings of the U.S. embassies in Nairobi and Dar es Salaam, 7 August 1998.

title: Cole
detail: USS Cole attacked at Aden, 12 October 2000.
Attacks on New York and the Pentagon, 11 September 2001.

title: OEF
detail: Operation Enduring Freedom begins in Afghanistan, 7 October 2001.

title: Saddam
detail: Saddam Hussein captured near Tikrit, 13 December 2003.

title: bin Laden
detail: Osama bin Laden killed in Abbottabad, 2 May 2011.

title: Iraq ends
detail: Last U.S. troops leave Iraq, 18 December 2011.

title: Benghazi
detail: Attack on the U.S. mission in Benghazi, 11 September 2012.

title: Trump
detail: Donald Trump inaugurated, 20 January 2017. In office at retirement.
